title: She gave grandpa her only scarf 🧣🥺
description:
The first cold night in Seoul. An old man with bare hands, and a little girl with a red scarf.

In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦

#Kindness #Grandpa #Seoul #Korea #Wholesome #shorts
